strategy.primary: Target-copy payloads: activate Zevlor ({2}, {T}), then cast an instant or sorcery that targets one opponent or their permanent, and it's copied for each other opponent. The deck runs single-target theft, draw and control spells (Cruel Ultimatum, Praetor's Grasp, Bribery, Acquire, River's Rebuke, Leadership Vacuum) that become table-wide.
strategy.secondary: Activation support (Training Grounds, Omen Hawker, Illusionist's Bracers, Pemmin's Aura, Patriar's Seal, Minamo, Twinning Staff) and magecraft engines that trigger on copies (Sedgemoor Witch, Storm-Kiln Artist).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Zevlor, Elturel Exile
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Haste
{2}, {T}: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only a single opponent or a single permanent an opponent controls this turn, for each other opponent, choose that player or a permanent they control, copy that spell, and the copy targets the chosen player or permanent.

identity.why: Copies single-target spells for each opponent.
